# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on [Polar](https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_qkpmJsVoK393Bp6lfOAEBDXz3r7wDIzUDs1wO2p31hb)
receives security fixes. Updates are free: download the new version from the same Polar link.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue**. Report it privately with GitHub:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/rrstudioapps/providentia/security/advisories/new)
(also under *Security → Report a vulnerability* in this repository).

Include the version, the affected page or file and the steps to reproduce. You will get an answer
as soon as possible. Once a fix is released, it is listed in the release notes, with credit if you want it.

## Scope

Providentia is a front-end template: it ships with a mock API and does not include a backend.
Reports about the template code (for example XSS, unsafe handling of tokens or of data from the
API) are in scope. Your own backend, and how you deploy the template, are not.
